Title: The most stupid idea for a deck ever...

Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
Volker, Calebros and small princes...

All you do it 1st tradition, Parity Shift, and secure haven on
calebros... Once you get the 1st tradition in play... Play smiling jack
and bam! While they can't take their turn, you sap their pool from
them... If they do take their turn, they get hit for the smiling jack,
AND 2 pool... Play a few second traditions just so they can't get the
smiling jack... Plays a few secret hordes just to get under your prey,
and parity shift away... Just a pure noviety deck, gonna actually try
it.. =D Just need to find a few more 1st traditions...

If I understand right... if you stack 2 first traditions, to take your
turn, you need to pay 4 pool, right? So in a 5 player game, if you had
the edge, and take your turn... You gain 1 from the edge, burn 4 for
playing your turn, add 1 to the smiling jack... Parity for 5 pool, and
then play another 1st tradition... net gain of 0 pool, and your prey
loses the same amount you did... Course anything can kill this deck,
but be ugly if it worked... =/ A few Dramatic Upheaval would make
things toast... Somebody at 5-7 pool? Move to his predator's spot, and
do the "Please take your turn taunt"
